pricing_status: Editorial planning allowances only; dates, family inventory, view premiums and holiday minimum stays unconfirmed.

stays.name: Green Mountain Inn
stays.tag: Historic charm · my first price check
stays.match: If you liked Mill Street Inn or Stone House
stays.title:
A village inn.
A fireside evening.
stays.intro: The closest match for a cozy, characterful inn, with Stowe village just outside the door.
stays.fit: King bedroom plus an adjoining living room with sofa bed. Request a crib and confirm a door between the rooms, stair-free access and occupancy for all three.
stays.trade: Traditional interiors. The pool is outdoors; this is a village stay, without a guaranteed mountain panorama.
stays.view: Village / inn setting. No specific view is promised for the Luxury Suite.
stays.fee: Three nights: $1,200–2,100 before tax and any fees.
stays.basis: Editorial holiday suite allowance, not a published rate or availability result. Price a Deluxe room as the cheaper fallback only if sharing one sleeping space works. Confirm the assigned building, crib, total fees and holiday cancellation terms.

stays.name: Stoweflake Mountain Resort
stays.match: If you liked Newport Beach Hotel & Suites
stays.title:
A separate bedroom.
A pool for cold afternoons.
stays.intro: The practical contender: family space, a gas fireplace and an indoor pool, with a more modest hotel feel.
stays.fit: King bedroom, living room with pullout sofa, refrigerator and dining table. Some suites have microwaves; request one plus a crib. The published category sleeps two adults and two children.
stays.trade: Less polished than the luxury options. No full kitchen in this suite. Confirm current pool and dining operations before booking; do not assume the full spa is operating.
stays.view: Balcony included; a mountain-facing suite is not guaranteed.
stays.fee: Add published fees of $18.50/night plus tax. Three nights: $1,105.50–2,005.50 before tax.
stays.basis: Editorial holiday suite allowance. Go Stowe publishes a general starting rate of $189; it is not a holiday suite quote. Published policy lists $15 resort + $3.50 destination fees per night and a 14-day winter cancellation deadline with full-stay penalty; your selected rate may differ. A standard room is the cheaper fallback without a separate bedroom.

stays.name: von Trapp Family Lodge
stays.tag: My pick for your alpine taste
stays.match: If you liked Weekapaug’s quiet retreat feeling
stays.title:
A little Austria.
A Vermont mountain retreat.
stays.intro: An Austrian-inspired hillside lodge with trails and an indoor pool. The strongest match for the mountain setting you enjoy.
stays.fit: King bedroom and living room with queen sleeper sofa. A refrigerator helps with baby snacks; there is no in-room microwave. Confirm crib placement and an elevator-accessible route to the suite.
stays.trade: Away from the village center. Traditional lodge decor, and breakfast is usually extra. The smaller Tyrol Suite has a sitting area, without an explicitly separate bedroom.
stays.view: Arlberg is explicitly described with mountain views from its balcony. Photos do not establish the exact winter sightline from your assigned room.
stays.fee: Add published $38/night Lodge resort fee plus tax. Three nights: $2,064–3,414 before tax.
stays.basis: Editorial holiday Arlberg Suite allowance, not a confirmed offer. Generic room deals do not establish this suite’s price. Request the Arlberg category by name; Nonnberg has two bedrooms but no separate seating area and requires stairs. Winter activities and family pool hours depend on the operating calendar.

stays.name: The Lodge at Spruce Peak
stays.match: If you liked Ocean House’s resort experience
stays.title:
The mountain outside.
Space to settle in.
stays.intro: The most complete resort option: mountain-base surroundings and a spacious suite with a kitchen and laundry.
stays.fit: Bedroom plus living room with sleeper sofa, full kitchen and washer/dryer. Confirm a crib. Junior Suites are a smaller alternative with a kitchenette and separate bedroom.
stays.trade: Peak ski-season prices can be steep even if you do not ski. The heated pool is outdoors. Mountain-base location is separate from Stowe village.
stays.view: Ask for Alpine for unobstructed Mount Mansfield views. Ridgeline means partial / obstructed views; Timberline mainly overlooks the resort village.
stays.fee: Three nights: $3,000–5,400+ before tax, resort fee and parking. Alpine view premiums may exceed this.
stays.basis: Editorial holiday one-bedroom allowance, not an Alpine-view quote. Exact dates, view category and minimum stay can move the price substantially. Compare Junior Suite and One-Bedroom totals with every fee; no holiday discount is assumed. Gallery labels distinguish the Junior Suite living room from the One-Bedroom bedroom.
